Sandbox_Extinction.ExtinctionDays_toolti: Every ordinary zombie receives one permanent random death date between the beginning of the apocalypse and the end of this period. The standard Months Since the Apocalypse setting is respected. A value of 0 causes immediate extinction. Project A-Life characters are not affected.
Sandbox_Extinction.SkeletonizationDays_t: After this many days, an ordinary zombie corpse is replaced with a lightweight, unidentifiable skeleton. Standard corpse-removal settings still apply. A value of 0 disables automatic skeletonization.
